text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio says she wants to have a change of pace, so I accompany her for some karaoke.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Karaoke is so fun, isn't it? We get to sing and dance! ♪ And most of all―

text_block_list.name: Karaoke Staff
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. Here are your three party platters.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Phew! I'm stuffed! Okay, on to the next song…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …Huh? What's wrong, Trainer? Is something on my face?
choice_data_list: Maybe you should ease up a bit.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Why? You think I'm gonna put on too much weight or something?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm fine! It's fine! I have complete and total control over my health!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I would never do anything to harm my races!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just then, a fast-paced song starts to play. It has an intricate dance routine that Teio's rather fond of.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: If you're so worried, then watch this! I'll show you my ultimate Teio Step dance routine!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant… Wow, my body feels really… heavy…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ohhh nooo! No, no, no, NO!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What should I do?! Here! You eat everything that's left!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And, um, can you give me some special training to fix this ASAP?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ughhh! I'm definitely gonna bounce back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, Tokai Teio manages get back into shape and is once again able to gracefully perform her Teio Step.
